//: Project-scoped MCP servers for Claude Code. Committed - contains no secrets, only ${ENV_VAR} references. Rationale, security notes and the deliberately-omitted list live in .cursor/docs/mcp-ecosystem.md

github.//: GitHub's OFFICIAL remote server. The old @modelcontextprotocol/server-github is archived and unmaintained (moved to modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived). X-MCP-Readonly stops an agent opening or merging PRs by accident - drop the header when you want write access.

postgres.//: Postgres MCP Pro. Replaces @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres, which is archived AND shipped a SQL-injection flaw that bypassed its own read-only restriction. --access-mode=restricted keeps it read-only. POSTGRES_READONLY_URL must still point at a role with SELECT only - the access mode is defence in depth, not the boundary.

context7.//: Version-accurate library docs. Highest-value server here: it is what stops the agent writing EF Core 6 or React Router v5 APIs against your pinned versions. Rule 00 requires *-gen skills to resolve the version from technologyStack.md and pull real docs before generating.

playwright.//: Browser automation for React E2E verification and RTL/visual checks. Heavy tool surface - turn it off for backend-only sessions.
